figures.label: Allocated Budget Share
figures.source: CIPET (Central Institute of Petrochemicals Engineering and Technology) is the most recognised, industry-linked training body specifically for plastics and polymer careers in India, and its placement pipeline is stronger for the processing and testing tracks than a general chemistry degree. Its government-institute fee structure also tends to sit well inside a sensible roughly-10%-of-education-budget planning rule; a private college charging materially more for a "polymer science" label needs real evidence, placement records, lab access, faculty industry links, before it is worth the premium.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 5 lakh education budget, a tenth is Rs 50,000 for the main course, and a fifth is Rs 1 lakh as a serious caution. The rest can fund a laptop, practice time and a reserve.
